end.subtitle: Reads everything. Writes nothing without you.

steps.caption: Ask about your own shop in your own words.
Forty-one tools read your sales, stock, customers and margins.
It can propose a change — a reorder, a price — but it cannot make one.
You approve it. Then it happens. That boundary never moves.
